fields.topology_type: Spanning tree of routers rooted at the host router; hub routers cascade the fabric; device routers are leaves. Each link is a USB-C dual-lane bidirectional connection.

supported_topologies.name: Daisy chain via hub routers
supported_topologies.description: Hub routers cascade additional downstream links.

supported_topologies.name: Host-to-Host
supported_topologies.description: Two host routers linked for PC-to-PC data.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Root of the tree; hosts the Connection Manager; allocates paths + tunnels.
Cascades the fabric; multiple downstream lane adapters; forwards tunneled + control packets.
Leaf; exposes USB3 / DisplayPort / PCIe adapters to be tunneled.
Host-resident manager; one per fabric; programs router config spaces.

fields.interconnect_role: USB4 is a tunneling fabric: routers forward encapsulated USB3 / DisplayPort / PCIe traffic over a shared transport layer along Connection-Manager-configured paths.

ordering_guarantees.per_tunnel_ordering: Native protocol ordering preserved end-to-end within each tunnel.
ordering_guarantees.isochronous_tunnels: DisplayPort + USB3 isochronous tunnels are bandwidth-reserved + TMU-synchronized.
ordering_guarantees.spanning_tree: No routing loops; a single path between any two routers.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: PCIe tunnels carry PCI Express memory/IO/config transactions; USB3 tunnels carry USB device traffic; DisplayPort tunnels carry isochronous video.

device_classification.host_router: Contains the Connection Manager + host interface adapter.
